meta.head: feat/rate-limit
meta.title: Token-bucket rate limiting
meta.summary: The change adds a token-bucket rate limiter and applies it to every public route.

chapters.title: Overview
chapters.narration: This change adds per-key rate limiting to the public API.

chapters.title: The TokenBucket type
chapters.narration: TokenBucket refills proportionally to elapsed time, then spends one token if available.

chapters.title: Per-key registry
chapters.narration: RateLimiter maps each API key to its bucket, creating one on first sight.

chapters.title: Middleware wiring
chapters.narration: The HTTP middleware asks the limiter for a token and short-circuits with a 429.

chapters.title: Old throttle removed
chapters.narration: The crude one-request-per-second throttle is deleted in favor of the bucket.

chapters.title: Wrap-up
chapters.narration: The API now enforces per-key budgets. Limits live in one module. Wiring is a single middleware.
